bias_check.principle: Markets price expectations, not your conviction — weigh valuation, the macro and the data, not just the story.

flags.title: Chasing strength
flags.note: Extended — 99% up its 52-week range, RS 100, -0% from the high. Momentum isn't an edge by itself — define risk/stop before chasing.
flags.lesson: The market prices expectations; a late entry carries the drawdown, not the edge.

flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Chemicals is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.76) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.
